work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: The act grants a plenary indulgence to those attending the Immaculate Conception Mass in the Franciscan convent of San Diego at Santa Fe de Bogotá. Issuer evidence GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF6194; own dating clause LF6245–6252 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctam Mariam Maio- ‘rem sub annulo piscatoris die decima nona iulii millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo primo, pontificatus Nostri anno primo.. Own provenance note LF6261 excluded as edition furniture. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
